VerdanturfTown_House_Text_TrainersGather:
Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY, is the POKéMON LEAGUE.
The TRAINERS who gather there are all frighteningly well skilled.
VerdanturfTown_House_Text_DefeatEliteFou:
In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the rules say that you have to battle the ELITE FOUR all in a row.
If you lose to any of them, you have to begin your challenge again from the first one.
